However, on 14 June it was decided by the DNCG to relegate Bordeaux administratively to the [[Championnat National]] for financial issues.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lemaître |first1=Clément |title=Bordeaux rétrogradé en National : La DNCG a officialisé sa décision ce mardi 14 juin 2022 |url=https://www.eurosport.fr/football/ligue-2/2021-2022/bordeaux-la-dncg-prononce-la-retrogradation-administrative-des-girondins-en-national_sto8992354/story.shtml |website=[[Eurosport]] |access-date=14 June 2022 |language=fr |date=14 June 2022 }}</ref> On 27 July 2022, Bordeaux won its appeal and was officially maintained in Ligue 2 for the 2022–23 season.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.girondins.com/fr/news/34672/le-club-maintenu-en-l2-la-fff-accepte-la-conciliation-du-cnosf |title=Le Club maintenu en L2 : la FFF accepte la conciliation du CNOSF |publisher=FC Girondins de Bordeaux |language=fr |date=27 July 2022 |access-date=27 July 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/La-fff-donne-son-accord-pour-le-maintien-de-bordeaux-en-ligue-2/1345582 |title=La FFF donne son accord pour le maintien de Bordeaux en Ligue 2 |publisher=L'Équipe |language=fr |date=27 July 2022 |access-date=27 July 2022}}</ref>
